items.title: Percy Stovall Interview, 1977-12-27
items.q: We used to travel with a boy named D. Clark then. And we was in the same hotel together.

ctx.x: He used to call his guitar that, he used to call his guitar the Devil. Yeah, yeah. What do you know about Ray Charles?

Well, Ray was a good friend of mine, was a good friend of mine. I knew when he started out, I remember when he used to travel, he came in his band and arrived in a little, at that time they used to make a little car called a disorder stage with a rag on the top, because all the band was buying him, you know. He had a little stuff placed in their back. And Ray used to come to Pensacola, I used to come to Pensacola, we used to play around Alabama and Pensacola pretty often. So Ray would come in there, and I met him…
New Orleans, you mean he just worked in?
